scripts.predev: docker start opero-postgres 2>/dev/null || true; for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker exec opero-postgres pg_isready -U opero >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 0.5; done; echo 'postgres did not become ready in time' >&2; exit 1
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c blue,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @opero/backend dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @opero/client dev"
